Profile

I have worked in learning and digital technology since 2000, from instructional writing and multimedia production to LMS/LXP architecture, UX, platform development and AI-assisted tools. I often work where learning, technology and change meet: explaining what users must do, designing the right experience and ensuring the technical delivery can support it.

My projects have included UN learning programmes, multilingual platforms, enterprise software adoption and independent educational tools. I work directly with subject experts and within L&D, product, technology and change teams. I am comfortable defining the scope, building the learning assets, working with developers and handing the result to the people who will run it.

I use tools such as Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Lovable where they help with quality or turnaround. The method matters less than whether the result works for its users.

Expertise

Learning design and production
Curriculum structure, scenarios, assessment, multimedia, accessibility and authoring for different audiences.
Learning technology and UX
Learner journeys, platform requirements, content architecture, localisation solutions, SCORM/xAPI integration and user testing. On client LMSs I tested, deployed and published SCORM with client-granted admin rights.
AI and prototyping
Small learning applications, AI-assisted production, experiment design, prompt workflows and hands-on team workshops.
Digital adoption and communications
Process learning, software simulations, role-based guides and training aligned with change programmes.
